notes:
A back button you can place on the page.

**Long-press the Link tool and choose "Back button"**, then tap where you want it. There is nothing to set up — no target to pick and no dialog afterwards.

Tapping it takes you back to whichever other piece you had open before this one, at the page you were on there. Unlike a two-way link it is not tied to one destination: it always returns to wherever you actually came from. It only remembers moves between pieces, so turning pages or following a link within the same piece will not change where it takes you.

**The reading light now stays in step between tablets**, in both directions and while the library is open. Changing it on the main tablet had no effect on the second one before.

**Pages and their markings always match.** A page could appear with the wrong markings, or on the wrong side of the spread, on pieces where the first page is hidden and the music starts on the right.

**The second tablet can be updated from the first**, so it never needs to join a network.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
